metadata.name: Rosa Luxemburg
metadata.description: Polish-German socialist theorist and revolutionary who advocated collective ownership, workers’ democracy and international solidarity, while opposing imperial war and bureaucratic repression.
metadata.scope: Provisional AI assessment for owner review. Political writings and activity from her entry into German Social Democracy through the 1918–1919 revolution. Modern policies are explicitly inferred from her principles; she never governed a national administration. Conflicting council and universal-democratic commitments are retained rather than flattened. All 240 responses are supplied. Some are low-confidence estimates from broader documented views, including counterfactual modern scenarios; these are not claims that the person expressed every listed opinion. Placement percentages describe this interpreted answer set, not certainty about the person’s beliefs.
